import pytest
from io import StringIO
from isort.api import sort_stream
from isort.exceptions import FileSkipSetting, ExistingSyntaxErrors

@pytest.fixture
def basic_config():
    from isort import Config
    return Config()

def test_sort_stream_basic(basic_config):
    input_stream = StringIO("from b import a\nimport c")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    changed = sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, extension="py", config=basic_config, show_diff=False)
    expected_output = "import c\nfrom b import a"
    output_stream.seek(0)
    assert changed is True
    assert output_stream.read() == expected_output

def test_sort_stream_with_skip(basic_config):
    input_stream = StringIO("# skip\nimport d\nfrom e import f")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    with pytest.raises(FileSkipSetting):
        sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, extension="py", config=basic_config, disregard_skip=False, file_path="example.py")

def test_sort_stream_syntax_error(basic_config):
    input_stream = StringIO("import a\n# invalid syntax\nimport b")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    with pytest.raises(ExistingSyntaxErrors):
        sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, extension="py", config=basic_config)

def test_sort_stream_atomic_on_change(basic_config):
    input_stream = StringIO("import b\nfrom a import c")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    changed = sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, extension="py", config=Config(atomic=True))
    expected_output = "from a import c\nimport b"
    output_stream.seek(0)
    assert changed is True
    assert output_stream.read() == expected_output

def test_sort_stream_show_diff(basic_config):
    input_stream = StringIO("import d\nimport a")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    changed = sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, extension="py", config=basic_config, show_diff=True)
    expected_output = "import a\nimport d"
    output_stream.seek(0)
    assert changed is True
    assert output_stream.read() == expected_output

def test_sort_stream_multiple_changes(basic_config):
    input_stream = StringIO("import z\nimport a\nfrom x import y")
    output_stream = StringIO()
    changed = sort_stream(input_stream, output_stream, extension="py", config=basic_config)
    expected_output = "from x import y\nimport a\nimport z"
    output_stream.seek(0)
    assert changed is True
    assert output_stream.read() == expected_output
